capture_rule: Capture the complete primary open article, article PDF, supplementary information, transparent peer review and complete source-data workbook for Pan et al., State-correlated reaction dynamics unveiled in full from a single product-image measurement, DOI 10.1038/s41467-025-66587-x. Preserve every incoming-channel identity, outgoing product-pair identity, product-state identity, angular-bin identity, speed and energy record, branching record, experimental, theoretical, fitted, normalized, estimated, tentative, background, control, limitation, adverse, reviewer and unresolved record in source order. Do not select by product state, scattering orientation, magnitude, agreement, condition, method, figure or apparent completeness. Do not fit, average, digitize an unreported value, infer a missing value, convert a theoretical result into measurement or repair a discrepancy.
source_selection_boundary: The DOI-identified complete article and its complete linked supplement, transparent peer review and source workbook are fixed before any target-bearing file opens, before executable-law registration, before candidate enumeration and before prediction-program construction. The source is selected structurally because it is a primary open experimental comparison with finite incoming preparation, pair-correlated outgoing product-state support, state-resolved angular distributions, complete linked source data and explicit experimental-versus-theoretical-versus-fitted-versus-tentative provenance. Observation informed the question and is disclosed; no observed product value, angular direction, branching fraction or desired agreement selects a Fold form.
